config.checkpoint_selection: Minimum validation cross-entropy over the fixed200 epochs; selected and final validation both reported. No test inference.
config.recipe: From-scratch random initialization. RGB is encoded as (0,R,G,B); stem uses fixed Hamilton Q multiplication. All18 residual convolutions are PHM with n=rank=4 and independent learned basis/core factors, no copied pretrained Q weights or fixed Hamilton bases. Scalar widths32/64/128, ordinary BN/ReLU, existing option-A shortcut layout and real10class readout. Random cores rescaled by sqrt(n) for expected effective-kernel He variance. Same200ep SGD recipe/split/augmentation/checkpoint selection as the existing baselines.272746 real trainables vs Q271594; not exact parameter equality.
config.scope: First ONE seed2026 baseline only. User keeps quaternion input/stem and permits learned PHM structure deeper. Fixed n4 is a bounded first step; this does not learn discrete n or guarantee algebra axioms. No test, hyperparameter sweep, automatic compression or fixed-vs-relearned-basis followup yet. Report failures and actual updates. Q and real prior baselines are controls, not initialization sources.
config.resume: Existing verified full-epoch model/SGD/scaler/best/RNG checkpoint. STOP in output pauses after a batch; incomplete epoch is repeated. Restart the same command after removing STOP.
